name: modal-close-centering
goal: Close icons stay visually centered in shared report dialogs on desktop, mobile and portable reports

evidence: Published Verification modal uses a centered text box whose multiplication glyph paints 2 pixels below center. Expected shared close icon paints within 1 pixel of center at desktop and mobile sizes.
Existing modal-detail tests prove opening, Escape and focus, but never painted icon alignment. Extend those same desktop/mobile cases with pixel-bound centering and close-button interaction.
/tmp/harness-modal-red.log: both unchanged standard modal cases fail with painted center offset 2 (limit 1). Before captures are under packages/reports/output/evidence/modal-before.
Shared Modal reuses HarnessIcon close; grid-centered 44px square button removes font baseline dependence while retaining labels and handlers.
/tmp/harness-modal-green.log: same unchanged desktop/mobile cases pass all three detail modals and close/Escape/focus interactions. Inspected after images show centered shared icon.

Reports bun run check passes: formatting, zero Svelte diagnostics, lint, 551 tests, builds and audit. Two focused portable browser cases pass; fresh screenshots inspected. Local file preview in Codex browser is policy-blocked; live report preview will be checked separately.
